Class ArrayParser<T,C>

java.lang.Object
com.saicone.types.parser.AllocParser<T>
com.saicone.types.parser.ArrayParser<T,C>
Type Parameters:
T - the type result of array.

All Implemented Interfaces:
TypeParser<T>, Function<Object,T>
public class ArrayParser<T,C> extends AllocParser<T>
Represents a parser that convert objects into an array.
